summary: This file is a pure configuration file (no callable functions, classes, or methods). It defines hyperparameters and settings for training an ImVoxelNet 3D object detection model with a SwinTransformer backbone on the ScanNet dataset using NeRF-based rendering in image mode with covariance-weighted mean volume representation.
note: No callable APIs exist in this file. It consists entirely of dictionary assignments, list definitions, and conditional variable mutations used by the MMDetection training framework.
